Have a Bayesian Julia package to share? [Ask us to showcase it](https://github.com/JuliaBayes/juliabayes.github.io/issues/new?template=suggest-package.yml) in the wider ecosystem.

Think JuliaBayes would be a good home for your package? [Request to bring it into JuliaBayes](https://github.com/JuliaBayes/juliabayes.github.io/issues/new?template=bring-package.yml).

Come say hello in [`#bayes` on Julia Slack](https://julialang.slack.com/archives/C0BKRUEN6CX) if you’d like to chat first!

Got code to talk about? Join the development discussion in [`#bayes-dev` on Julia Slack](https://julialang.slack.com/app_redirect?channel=bayes-dev).

[Subscribe to package releases (RSS)](/releases.xml).
